Evan — thanks for confirming. Confirming Tue, Mar 23 3:00–4:00 PM PT. Joining from Redwood: Marissa Cole (hiring manager), Vivek Kulkarni (ML Infra), Jordan Blake (interviewer — coding).

Quick prep:
- Format: 60 minutes total: 30m live coding on CoderPad, 25–30m ML infra / system design, 5m candidate Q&A.
- Coding: please be ready for a medium difficulty algorithmic problem (focus on correctness + clear communication). We occasionally ask for small utilities or data-processing snippets relevant to model infra.
- System design: focus topics include model serving at scale, caching strategies, KV cache tradeoffs, throughput/latency tradeoffs, and deployment/rollback strategies.
- Bring a laptop with a modern browser; we use CoderPad for the coding portion.

CoderPad link (will open at interview time): https://coderpad.io/session/REDW-evan-0326
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-evan-ml-screen
